ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a central regular hexagon. On each of the six sides of the hexagon there is a square attached outward. Between each pair of neighboring squares, there is a triangular gap/region, giving six triangles around the hexagon. Reasoning: The problem states that the regular hexagon has side length 18 cm. Each attached square uses one side of the hexagon as a side, so every square has side length 18 cm. At each vertex of the regular hexagon, the adjacent outward square sides form a triangle. Since the regular hexagon has exterior angle 60°, and the two square sides forming each such triangle are both 18 cm, each triangle is equilateral, so its exposed outer side is also 18 cm. The outer perimeter consists of one exposed outer side from each of the six squares and one exposed outer side from each of the six triangles, for 12 exposed sides total. Therefore P = 12 × 18 = 216.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a central regular hexagon is surrounded by six congruent squares, one built on each side of the hexagon, and the gaps between neighboring squares are six triangles. Read from the text that each side of the regular hexagon is 18 cm. Since each attached square uses a hexagon side as one of its sides, every square side is also 18 cm. At each vertex of the regular hexagon, two adjacent square sides form a triangle; because the regular hexagon has exterior angle 60° and the adjacent square sides are equal to 18 cm, each such triangle is equilateral, so its exposed outer side is 18 cm. The outer perimeter consists of one outer side from each of the six squares plus one outer side from each of the six triangles, so there are 12 exposed sides of length 18. Therefore P = 12 × 18 = 216.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the whole shape is assembled from a central regular hexagon, six surrounding squares sharing sides with the hexagon, and six triangles each sharing two sides with neighboring squares. From the text, the hexagon side is 18 cm, so each square has side 18 cm. From the visual geometry at each hexagon vertex, the triangle between two adjacent squares has two sides of length 18 meeting at 60°, so it is equilateral with all sides 18 cm. Compute the sum of perimeters of all component pieces before gluing: hexagon perimeter = 6×18, six squares contribute 6×4×18, and six triangles contribute 6×3×18. This gives 108 + 432 + 324 = 864. Now subtract the internal shared seams twice: the six hexagon-square shared sides have total length 6×18, and each of the six triangles shares two sides with squares, giving 12 more shared sides of length 18. Internal shared length is (6+12)×18 = 324, counted twice in the component perimeter sum. Thus outer perimeter P = 864 − 2×324 = 216.

推理：因为每个正方形与正六边形的一条边共边，所以每个正方形边长也是18 cm。由正六边形顶点处的几何关系，相邻两个正方形之间形成的三角形有两条边分别等于正方形边长18 cm，且夹角为60°，所以这些三角形是边长为18 cm的等边三角形。

内部共边包括：正六边形与6个正方形共用的6条边，总长6×18；每个三角形与两个正方形共用边，共6×2=12条边，总长12×18。因此内部共边总长为(6+12)×18=324。内部共边在组件周长总和中被计算了两次，所以外周长P=864−2×324=216。
